q: In a stage shop, what is a 'flat'?
o: A wooden-framed, covered panel used as scenery

q: A 'gel' is a colored sheet placed in front of a ___.
Which stage type has the audience seated on three sides of the playing area?
o: Black box with seats in one row
e: A thrust stage projects into the audience.

q: The fly system is used to ___.
o: Raise and lower scenery and equipment above the stage

q: A production calendar is used to ___.
o: Schedule rehearsals, builds and performance dates

q: What happens at a technical rehearsal?
o: Cast and crew run cues for lights, sound and scenery changes

q: Before using a power saw in the shop, a student should ___.
o: Wear eye protection and get approval from the shop supervisor
e: Tool safety starts with PPE and supervision.

q: Why must exit paths backstage stay clear?
o: To make the room look larger
So people can leave quickly in a fire or emergency

q: When reading a script for technical needs, a student underlines every mention of sounds, such as a doorbell. She is making a list of ___.
A stage direction says 'Night. Moonlight enters through the window.' This tells the lighting designer about ___.
o: Time of day and the type of light needed

q: A realistic living-room play and an abstract dance piece would likely use ___ scenery.
In a fantasy genre production, which technical element often supports the world of the story?
o: Special lighting, costumes and scenery that suggest a magical setting

q: Which order best lists the steps of the design process?
e: The process begins with analysis and ends with evaluation.

q: During the 'research' step of design, a student might ___.
o: Collect images and facts about the play's time and place

q: Who is in charge of coordinating all aspects of a production and communicating the vision?
Which member of the production team calls cues during a performance?
A scenic designer and lighting designer talk before the build so the paint colors and lights work together. This shows ___.
A crew head assigns tasks, checks progress and encourages teammates. She is showing ___.
A student chooses a color palette for a costume that shows a character's mood. This is ___ in design.
Which choice shows creativity in prop design?
o: Building an original prop that fits the story

q: A designer gives the director a rendering and a swatch board for the costumes. These are ways to ___.
A prompt book is a ___.
o: Script with blocking, cues and notes used to run the show
e: The prompt book guides the performance.

q: A carpenter measures a board that is 8 feet long and needs two pieces of 3 feet each. How much is left over?
Which tool is used to measure a length for a scenery board?
What should you do with a hand saw when you finish a cut?
o: Put it back in its proper storage place
Leave it on the stage floor
Hand it to someone blade first

q: Which item protects a student's eyes while sanding scenery?
Which part of the lighting system raises and lowers brightness?
Before hanging a light, a student should ___.
o: Check the safety cable and clamp and use a safe ladder with a partner

q: When applying stage makeup, a performer should ___.
o: Use clean tools and avoid sharing products that touch the eyes or mouth

q: Why use a thimble or pincushion when hand-sewing a costume?
o: To protect fingers and keep pins organized

q: Which action keeps sound equipment safe?
o: Keep drinks away from the sound board and tape down cables

q: Why should a sound operator keep volume levels in check?
e: Loud sound can damage ears and speakers.

q: The house manager is responsible for ___.
o: Audience seating, safety and the front-of-house operations

q: Which person keeps the rehearsal and performance running smoothly backstage?
A designer researching a 1920s dress studies photos, fashion magazines and museum collections. She is establishing ___.
Why does cultural accuracy matter in theatrical design?
o: It removes the need for rehearsal
It respects the culture shown and helps the audience believe the world

q: Compared with live theatre, film allows ___.
o: Close-ups and editing that can change the audience's view instantly

q: Which statement shows the impact of electronic media on theatre?
o: Projections and digital sound are now used in many live productions
e: Technology is integrated into live shows.

q: Greek theatre in ancient Athens used masks and an open-air amphitheater. This is part of the ___ of world theatre.
e: World theatre has a rich heritage.

q: Which key figure is known for plays performed at the Globe Theatre?
The United States contributed major innovations to stage lighting and design. One example is ___.
Broadway is known for contributing which form that mixes music, dance and drama?
e: The musical is an American innovation.

q: A technical theatre portfolio usually includes ___.
o: Photos, drawings and notes showing a student's design and build work

q: A resume for a technical theatre student lists ___.
o: Experience, skills and productions worked on

q: At a live performance, an audience member should ___.
o: Silence phones and respect the performers and others

q: Behavior at an outdoor theatre festival may differ from a formal theatre because ___.
A student reflects that a well-lit scene made the actors' expressions clear. She is evaluating the design as part of an ___.
Self-evaluation after building a set helps a student ___.
o: Identify what worked and what to improve

q: A review that describes how the costumes and lighting supported the mood of the play is ___.
Which sentence evaluates a live play precisely?
o: The warm amber lights during the kitchen scene made the family feel close
e: Precise observations name the element and effect.

q: A student reviews a film and notes how sound design heightened tension in a chase. She is evaluating ___.
e: Film review can be as precise as theatre review.

q: When evaluating a TV drama, which comment is specific?
o: The color grading made the flashbacks look faded and distant

q: A student who enjoys building scenery learns that carpenters, designers and technicians work in many careers. She is ___ theatre skills to careers.
Which skill from technical theatre helps in many careers?
A student posts photos of her light plot and a short explanation on a class website. She is using ___ to present findings.
A clear slideshow of a technical project should ___.
o: Use labeled images and short, organized text
